create_egl_display: create an initialized headless EGL display on an available GPU device
build_egl_context: build an EGLContext with a given max width and height for headless rendering
init_egl_context: initialize an EGL context by choosing a framebuffer config and binding the OpenGL API
make_egl_current: make an EGL context current on the calling thread for rendering operations
free_egl_context: free an EGL context and destroy its associated resources safely
